start: A member who ticked the last set at 7:40 pm with 2 min rest, then left the workout open and the app on screen

steps.action: Come back to the phone at 9:10 pm
user_sees: The workout timer stopped; the line 'Paused at 7:42 pm: no sets for an hour. Tick a set to carry on, or finish the workout.'
must_not: The pause dated at 8:40 pm (when the hour ran out) instead of 7:42 pm

user_sees: The saved length ends near 7:42 pm, not 9:10 pm
must_not: Over 1.5 h of idle time in the workout's length

start: A member who ticked the last set at 6:00 pm, swiped the app away and reopens it at 8:30 pm

user_sees: About 3 seconds later, the workout shows 'Paused at 6:02 pm: no sets for an hour. Tick a set to carry on, or finish the workout.'
must_not: Sets ticked from the notification shade while the app was closed ignored before measuring

steps.action: Tick a set to carry on
user_sees: The timer runs again; a line 'Timer paused 6:02 pm to 8:31 pm while no sets were logged.' with 'Count it'
must_not: The paused time counted without asking

start: A member who opens a Plank set's hold timer and leaves it, before or after pressing Start

steps.action: Leave the hold timer panel open for 2 hours
user_sees: No auto-pause while a set is really being timed
must_not: The workout paused and back-dated while a set is being timed
The workout never pausing because a timer panel was opened but never started

steps.action: Edit a past workout, or log a past workout, and leave it open 2 hours
must_not: A past workout's times changed by an auto-pause

start: A member whose workout paused itself, now back and training

user_sees: The timer resumes; 'Timer paused X to Y while no sets were logged.' with 'Count it'
The idle span added back to the workout's length
must_not: The same span paused again a minute later

steps.action: Leave it again for another hour
user_sees: A new pause, starting after the counted span
must_not: A pause back-dated inside time already counted

start: Promise: paused time and who sees the length

steps.action: Finish a workout that paused itself
user_sees: The saved length leaves the paused time out unless counted
must_not: Paused time counted in the length, the gym leaderboard or the trainer summary

start: The app is open on the workout screen; the last tick was 61 minutes of trained time ago

user_sees: The workout's pause set at the last action plus its rest
must_not: A pause when the app is in the background (the check waits for it to be active)
A pause at the current time instead of back-dated

start: The app comes back to the screen after being in the background

user_sees: The check runs once 3 seconds later, after shade or watch ticks are saved
must_not: Two checks stacking from two quick returns

start: A workout already paused, a past log being edited, or the hold timer open

must_not: A second pause over the first
A crash when the store read fails (the check never throws)

start: A workout where the member pressed 'Count it' for a 7:42 pm to 9:10 pm span

steps.action: The check runs at 9:20 pm with no tick since 9:10
user_sees: No new pause, because a new pause may only start after 9:10 pm
